artifacts.summary: Added FormalSystem/Examples/Walkthrough.lean, a six-leg end-to-end walkthrough of the TM metatheory, with its axiom sets asserted in Tests/BimodalTest/WalkthroughAxioms.lean and the README demo pointer repointed to it.

completion_data.completion_summary: Added FormalSystem/Examples/Walkthrough.lean: 25 named, docstringed declarations carrying two concrete formulas through a hand-built and an automation-found derivation, soundness, completeness, the tableau decision procedure, frame-class sensitivity by one concrete integer countermodel, and the proved strong-completeness refutation at ZTime. Every declaration's axiom set is asserted with #guard_msgs in Tests/BimodalTest/WalkthroughAxioms.lean, and the root README demo link now points here instead of BimodalProofs.lean.
